body:
Show 'No notes yet' + New note button when list is empty.

- unit test in app/notes/__tests__/empty.test.tsx

title: Deduct 1 credit per AI summary, atomically
body:
AC:
- each summary deducts exactly 1 credit in the same transaction as the summary row
- concurrent requests never drive balance below 0 (test with 20 parallel calls)
- 402 when balance is 0
